rows.commentary: 0.1: Muzahir Raza drifts the opening delivery down to long-on where Vishen Halambage scampers through for a single to get off the mark.
0.2: Sangeeth Cooray does not score off Muzahir Raza.
0.3: Muzahir Raza strikes early as Sangeeth Cooray chips it straight to Shafiq Jan, departing without scoring after facing two deliveries.
0.4: Muzahir Raza attacks the stumps, allowing Movin Subasingha to flick a gentle single out towards long-on.
0.5: Muzahir Raza bowls a wide to Vishen Halambage.
0.5: Muzahir Raza drops slightly short and Vishen Halambage launches it with tremendous power over deep mid-wicket for a massive maximum.
0.6: Muzahir Raza corrects his length, but Vishen Halambage works it securely into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
1.1: Shafiq Jan enters the attack and is immediately punished as Vishen Halambage dispatches the ball all the way over deep backward point for six.
2.2: Movin Subasingha loops it up and Usman Ali Afridi launches it high and handsome over long-on for a maximum.
2.3: Movin Subasingha is targeted again as Usman Ali Afridi repeats the dose, depositing another maximum over long-on.
2.4: Movin Subasingha keeps it full, allowing Usman Ali Afridi to push a single down to long-on.
2.5: Movin Subasingha angles this one wide, and Zohaib Amanat guides it toward deep extra cover for a single.
2.6: Movin Subasingha tosses it up, and Usman Ali Afridi rotates the strike with a single to long-on.
3.1: Wijesinghe drifts into the arc, and Usman Ali Afridi unleashes a massive blow sailing over long-off for six.
3.2: Wijesinghe strays in line, and Usman Ali Afridi whips it away with immense power behind square leg for another maximum.
3.3: Wijesinghe finds himself punished once more as Usman Ali Afridi clears long-on effortlessly for six.
3.4: Wijesinghe pulls back his length, and Usman Ali Afridi collects a single out to deep mid-wicket.
3.5: Wijesinghe drops short and Zohaib Amanat brutally pulls it away to the deep square leg boundary for four.
3.6: Wijesinghe is punished at the death of the over, launched monstrously over deep mid-wicket for six by Zohaib Amanat.
4.1: Dot ball from Muditha Lakshan to Usman Ali Afridi.
4.2: Muditha Lakshan bowls a wide to Usman Ali Afridi.
4.2: Muditha Lakshan wins the battle as Usman Ali Afridi skies one to be safely caught by Wijesinghe, departing for a brilliant 46 off 14 balls including seven sixes.
4.3: Muditha Lakshan darts this full, and Aamir Kaleem steers it firmly toward deep extra cover for a single.
4.4: Muditha Lakshan drops it short, and Zohaib Amanat fiercely hooks it all the way over deep backward point for a maximum.
